commentary.text: 90+7' Michael Salisbury is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' Joao Palhinha (Tottenham) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
90+4' 1 - 1 Goal! Pape Matar Sarr plays a short, square pass into the path of Joao Palhinha (Tottenham), who bends a shot straight into the right side of the goal to make it 1:1. Fabulous goal!
90+2' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jhon Arias trots off the pitch and is replaced by Toti (Wolves).
90+2' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Jhon Arias (Wolves).
90+2' Toluwalase Emmanuel Arokodare (Wolves) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Corner kick. Wolves will have an opportunity.
90+1' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) commits a rough challenge and Michael Salisbury blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Wolves.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
89' Toluwalase Emmanuel Arokodare (Wolves) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
88' Toluwalase Emmanuel Arokodare (Wolves) picks up an injury.
86' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Sam Johnstone, who smothers the ball.
84' Thomas Frank decides to make a substitution. Destiny Udogie will be replaced by Mathys Tel (Tottenham).
84' Jorgen Strand Larsen goes off the pitch and Toluwalase Emmanuel Arokodare (Wolves) comes on.
83' Joao Palhinha (Tottenham) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way over the bar.
82' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well over the bar.

80' Sam Johnstone doesn't have to worry about that one. Pedro Porro puts a cross in towards Richarlison (Tottenham), who is unable to keep his header on target from the centre of the box. He sends the ball well wide of the left post.
78' Thomas Frank has decided to make a change. Wilson Odobert (Tottenham) replaces Xavi Simons.
78' The referee signals a substitution. Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) is brought on as a substitute for Lucas Bergvall.
77' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Xavi Simons (Tottenham), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

77' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The ball goes behind for a corner. Tottenham will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
75' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) launches a cross from the corner, but Guglielmo Vicario is alert to thwart the effort.
75' The corner is swung in but Wolves can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. The ball is out of play. Wolves win a corner kick.

74' A pass into the box finds Hugo Bueno (Wolves) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the bottom left corner, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Guglielmo Vicario denies him. Wolves force a corner. They send men into the box.
72' Poor challenge! Marshall Munetsi (Wolves) is penalised for tripping and Michael Salisbury blows his whistle. Tottenham earn a free kick.
68' Chance! Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) took a nice pass in his stride in the box, but scuffed his shot just wide of the left post.
67' Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Wolves win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
65' Lucas Bergvall (Tottenham) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Michael Salisbury had an easy-decision to make.
64' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Joao Gomes as he is replaced by Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves).
63' Here is a change. Djed Spence is going off and Thomas Frank gives the last tactical orders to Pedro Porro (Tottenham).
62' Substitution. Rodrigo Bentancur makes his way off the pitch and Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) comes on as his replacement.
62' Xavi Simons (Tottenham) sends the corner into the box, but Sam Johnstone intercepts it and averts the threat.
61' Xavi Simons (Tottenham) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out for a corner. Tottenham can continue in their attacking effort.
59' Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
58' Andre (Wolves) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Michael Salisbury stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Tottenham have a free kick.
57' 5:7 – the total goal attempt statistics. The number of shots on goal at present is 2:2.
54' 0 - 1 Goal! A rebound wrong foots everyone except Santiago Bueno (Wolves), and he slams the ball into the open net from close range. 0:1.
54' Ladislav Krejci (Wolves) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the left side of the goal is brilliantly kept out by the goalkeeper.
54' Jhon Arias (Wolves) will deliver the corner kick.

53' Jackson Tchatchoua (Wolves) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The ball is out of play. Wolves will have a chance to score from a corner.

53' Andre (Wolves) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Michael Salisbury no option but to blow his whistle. Tottenham are awarded a free kick.
51' Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
50' Xavi Simons (Tottenham) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
49' Santiago Bueno (Wolves) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee. Tottenham are awarded the free kick.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Matt Doherty (Wolves) comes off for Emmanuel Agbadou.
46' Half-time substitution. Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) will not participate anymore and Jackson Tchatchoua is coming on.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' Michael Salisbury blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+4' Matt Doherty (Wolves) misses a great chance after firing a volley onto the crossbar of the goal.
45+4' Jhon Arias (Wolves) takes the corner.
45+4' A cross from Jhon Arias (Wolves) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The ball goes out of play. Wolves are awarded a corner kick.
45+3' Jhon Arias (Wolves) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
45+3' Jhon Arias (Wolves) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger. Wolves earn a corner.
45+1' Xavi Simons (Tottenham) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
45' Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Tottenham.
44' The foul by Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) was seen by Michael Salisbury who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle. Wolves win a free kick.

43' Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham) bursts into the box after a fine solo run. He looks up and tries to place a shot inside the left post, but Sam Johnstone makes a great save to deny him his moment of glory.
41' Lucas Bergvall (Tottenham) smacks a great volley at goal from inside the box, but sends the effort just inches over the bar.
41' Xavi Simons (Tottenham) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

40' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. Tottenham have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
39' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Joao Gomes (Wolves) was quite harsh and Michael Salisbury didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
39' A precise low pass is received by Jhon Arias (Wolves), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar.
38' Marshall Munetsi (Wolves) is able to continue to play.
37' Marshall Munetsi (Wolves) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
36' Richarlison (Tottenham) attempts to find Lucas Bergvall, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
35' Matt Doherty (Wolves) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
33' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Jhon Arias (Wolves), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
32' Michael Salisbury shows a yellow card to Xavi Simons (Tottenham) for his blatant foul.
32' Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham) takes the corner kick, but Sam Johnstone reads it well and stops the effort.
31' The ball is cleared after Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Tottenham get a corner.

30' Micky van de Ven (Tottenham) connects with a cross from the side and steers a header from around the penalty spot towards the goal. The ball goes in the right direction, but it's stopped by one of the defenders.
30' Xavi Simons (Tottenham) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
30' The resulting corner from Xavi Simons (Tottenham) is cleared by the defence. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Tottenham.
29' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee signals a corner kick to Tottenham.
28' The goal by Tottenham is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
28' That looked like an offside in the build-up play and the referee Michael Salisbury is going to take a look using VAR.
27' Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham) has a goal ruled out for offside!
27' Andre (Wolves) tackles a bit over-zealously and Michael Salisbury blows for a foul. Tottenham are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
25' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) receives a pass and tries his luck with a long-range powerful effort. His poorly placed shot lacks accuracy and flies miles wide of the right post.
24' Jhon Arias (Wolves) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.

24' Hugo Bueno (Wolves) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. Wolves have been awarded a corner kick.
23' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) chips a pass over the line of defenders to get the ball to Lucas Bergvall, but his attempt is intercepted and cleared.

22' Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Michael Salisbury blows his whistle for an infringement. Free kick. Wolves will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
22' The resulting corner from Xavi Simons (Tottenham) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
21' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Tottenham have been awarded a corner kick.
20' The Tottenham players are exchanging some short passes.
18' Matt Doherty (Wolves) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
17' Djed Spence (Tottenham) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Michael Salisbury blows his whistle for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Wolves.
15' Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham) connects with a cross deep inside the box to send a nice header towards the bar. The ball bounces off it, though, and the goalkeeper saves.
13' Xavi Simons (Tottenham) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
12' The resulting corner from Xavi Simons (Tottenham) is cleared by the opposition's defence. The ball goes out of play. Tottenham are awarded a corner kick.
12' That looked a certain handball by Matt Doherty (Wolves) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
12' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. It will be a corner kick for Tottenham.
9' Jhon Arias (Wolves) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
8' Jhon Arias (Wolves) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Good work from Wolves as they win a corner.
6' Jorgen Strand Larsen receives a sweet cross inside the box from Marshall Munetsi (Wolves), but one of the defenders rushes in bravely to intercept the ball.
4' Jhon Arias (Wolves) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
4' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Wolves.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Tottenham will have the kick-off.
Michael Salisbury will supervise the game today.
